_comment: PARAMETERS OF A SIMULATION, NOT MEASUREMENTS.
The scripted backend stands in for the target LLM when no Ollama host is
reachable. It executes the AgentDojo ground truth for the user task, and
when it reads an injected tool result it switches to the injection task's
ground truth with the probability given below. The environments, the tool
implementations, the utility checker and the security checker are all
AgentDojo's real ones — only the agent's *policy* is simulated.
The per-template probabilities encode the ordering the literature reports
for AgentDojo (important_instructions strongest). They are inputs, not
findings. Any number produced with backend='scripted' must be labelled as
such, and every table in arena/eval/ prints the backend column.
Set SENTINELZ_LLM_BACKEND=ollama once a model is available to replace all
of this with real behaviour. Nothing else changes.
